title: Harmonic morphisms and dynamical invariants in network renormalization
summary: Renormalization of complex networks requires principled criteria for assessing whether a coarse-graining preserves dynamical content. We prove that discrete harmonic morphisms -- surjective maps preserving harmonic functions -- provide the minimal condition under which random walks on a fine-grained network project exactly onto random walks on its coarse-grained image, through an appropriate random time change.
